links.note: The meaning of democracy - this concept gives demos, people, and kratos, rule or power, so democracy is the rule of the people - and then explains why all people cannot rule directly, which is the ground of the direct-against-representative distinction the second half asks for.

Why three tiers are needed - this concept's principle, that the same event is handled at a different level depending on its scale, with the bulb and the flood as its two illustrations. Already linked and correct.
Why rules are necessary when many people live together - this concept states that disagreements and disorder arise, so rules become necessary to maintain order and harmony in society.
Governance defined as the process of taking decisions, organising the society's life with different sets of rules, and ensuring that they are followed - this concept's definition, word for word.
Government defined as the group of individuals or the system that makes the rules and ensures that they are followed - this concept's definition.
Rules and laws not being set once and for all - this concept's closing point, that citizens also have a say in the laws and rules governing society. Already linked and correct.
Some of the more important rules being called laws - this concept's third definition, beside governance and government.

The judiciary examining whether a law passed by the legislature is well conceived and fair, as part of the checks and balances - both halves of the pair are this concept's sentences. Already linked and correct.

Direct democracy against representative democracy - this concept is where the picnic vote is named as a case of direct democracy, every student's opinion being taken, against the representative system described just before it.

Grassroots democracy as a system that enables and encourages the participation of ordinary citizens, who can then have a say in decisions that affect them - this concept's definition. Already linked and correct.
The state assembly or Vidhan Sabha - this concept's table gives it as the state-level legislature, against the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha at the national level.
Police, law and order among the state executive's functions - this concept's table lists them, against currency and foreign affairs on the Central side.
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam nicknamed the Missile Man of India for his role in the space, missile and nuclear programmes - this concept's profile. Already linked and correct.
Why all the people cannot rule directly - this concept asks exactly that and answers that it is clearly not possible, then uses the class representative to explain why representation exists.
India as the world's largest democracy with some 970 million voters in 2024, and all citizens above 18 entitled to vote - this concept states both. Already linked and correct.

A national law debated and voted on in the national capital points to Parliament, which this concept's table gives as the two houses at the national level, the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha, that formulate national laws.
Kalam's rise from a humble family in Rameswaram to the Presidency, and the humility and dedication the chapter credits him with - this concept's profile. Already linked and correct.
E.N.D. means Effort Never Dies - one of the sayings this concept quotes, alongside F.A.I.L. as First Attempt In Learning and N.O. as Next Opportunity.
Members of Legislative Assembly or MLAs at the state level - this concept gives the term beside MPs at the national level.
Some 970 million voters in 2024 - this concept's figure. Already linked and correct.
All Indian citizens above the age of 18 having the right to participate in elections - this concept's statement, which is what makes the voter number as large as it is.
